headline: Hyperscale Data Warns of Cash Deficit for $1.2B Michigan AI Data Center
summary: Bitcoin miner Hyperscale Data warned it needs another $74.8 million to complete its $1.2 billion Michigan data center project after selling its remaining bitcoin and raising fresh debt.
why: Hyperscale Data is a data center operator and former cryptocurrency miner expanding into artificial intelligence infrastructure.

impacts.name: Hyperscale Data
impacts.why: The company faces a $74.8 million cash shortfall required to complete its flagship AI data center project.
